goal: Create a self-contained 3D neon portal web demo (index.html, or index.html + scene.js + engine3d.js + app.js) with a software 3D renderer on a full-viewport <canvas id="c">, dark radial-gradient space background, a two-tier platform, twin pillars, lintel and crown cap (36 box faces), six orbiting octahedral crystals (48 triangles), a portal core with two counter-rotating rings, a cyber grid floor, 180 twinkling stars, 110 rising particles, an orbiting camera, and a glassmorphism HUD (NEON PORTAL 3D, FPS/POLYS/PARTS, Pause/Orbit ON/Reset buttons, speed slider).
verify_commands: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),vm=require("vm");const h=fs.readFileSync("index.html","utf8");if(!/id=["\x27]c["\x27]/.test(h))throw new Error("missing canvas#c");for(const t of["NEON PORTAL 3D","FPS","POLYS","PARTS","Pause","Reset"])if(!h.includes(t))throw new Error("missing "+t);for(const m of h.matchAll(/<script\b([^>]*)>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/gi)){const a=m[1],s=a.match(/src=["\x27]([^"\x27]+)["\x27]/i);if(s)new vm.Script(fs.readFileSync(s[1],"utf8"),{filename:s[1]});else if(m[2].trim())new vm.Script(m[2],{filename:"inline.js"});}console.log("OK")'
constraints: Full-viewport <canvas id="c"> with dark radial-gradient space background and custom software 3D projection/painter's-algorithm renderer.
Build portal monument from 6 boxes (two-tier platform, twin pillars, lintel, crown cap) = 36 box faces with neon edges and shaded faces.
Render 6 orbiting octahedral crystals = 48 triangles total, rotating smoothly around the portal with glowing edges and shading.
Render portal core with swirling energy glow and 2 counter-rotating 3D rings, plus a perspective cyber grid floor beneath the platform.
Render 180 twinkling background stars and 110 rising glowing neon particles with lifecycle recycling.
Implement orbiting camera with smooth auto-orbit and mouse/pointer drag + wheel zoom support.
Add glassmorphism HUD displaying 'NEON PORTAL 3D', live FPS/POLYS/PARTS counters, Pause, Orbit ON/OFF, Reset buttons, and speed slider.
Keep app self-contained with no external CDN/network dependencies so index.html works offline when opened directly.
